summary.text: A shepherd descended from Udaeus, one of the original Spartoi. He was the father of the great prophet Tiresias by the nymph Chariclo.
A shepherd of Thebes, descended from Udaeus one of the Spartoi sown by Cadmus.

story.text: A shepherd of Thebes who traced his lineage back to the dragon's teeth sown by Cadmus. He married the nymph Chariclo and became the father of Tiresias.
